title: Ground Truth Event Set (Paper A RQ1 验证基准)
description: 事后确认的真实供应链中断事件集。每条事件用于前视验证：LLM 信号必须严格早于 gt_onset_date 且 temporality 为 forward_looking/latent 才算命中。onset 日期为事后认定（v0.1 为知识草稿，标 * 的待网络核实）。

events.onset_evidence: Houthi forces seized the vehicle carrier Galaxy Leader near Hodeidah on 2023-11-19; Wikipedia records that Houthi attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea began that day. Corroborated by the Wikipedia articles 'Red Sea crisis' and 'Galaxy Leader' (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches both.
events.notes: 经典 geoeconomic 中断；预警信号可能出现在袭击开始前（地缘紧张、胡塞声明、保险费用上涨）。

events.event_name: Ever Given blockage of Suez Canal
events.onset_evidence: Ever Given ran aground in the Suez Canal on 2021-03-23 and was refloated on 2021-03-29, closing the canal for six days. Corroborated by the Wikipedia article '2021 Suez Canal obstruction' (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the grounding date.
events.notes: 突发型事件，几乎无预警信号（黑天鹅）。作为 baseline：验证集中应含此类'难预警'事件以检验系统性。

events.event_name: US semiconductor export controls on China
events.onset_evidence: The Bureau of Industry and Security issued the new advanced-computing and semiconductor manufacturing export controls for immediate release on 2022-10-07; compliance deadlines followed on 2022-10-12 and 2022-10-21. Corroborated by the Wikipedia article 'United States New Export Controls on Advanced Computing and Semiconductors to China' (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the announced issue date.
events.notes: 法规型事件，预警信号可能在发布前（政策草案、媒体报道、游说新闻）出现。

events.onset_evidence: The Wuhan municipal government announced a lockdown of the city effective 10:00 on 2020-01-23, extended to other cities in Hubei. Corroborated by the Wikipedia article 'COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei' (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the announced effective date.
events.notes: 大范围系统性事件；预警信号可能在封城前（疫情早期报道、世卫声明）。

events.event_name: Renesas Kumamoto earthquake halts chip plant
events.onset_evidence: The Kumamoto mainshock is timestamped 2016-04-15 16:25:06 UTC, i.e. 2016-04-16 01:25 JST; the stored date is the local (JST) calendar date, which is the convention used throughout this table. Corroborated by the Wikipedia article '2016 Kumamoto earthquakes' (checked 2026-09-30). NOTE: a UTC-dated series would place this onset on 2016-04-15, one day earlier.
events.notes: 突发型；地震预警难以提前，但工厂库存/供应链依赖度报道可能在事前存在。

events.event_name: US West Coast port congestion (LA/Long Beach)
events.onset_evidence: White House announcement (2021-10-13) that the Port of Los Angeles would shift to 24/7 operations, following Long Beach.
events.notes: 慢发性；预警信号（拥堵指数、船期延误、码头利用率）可能在官方宣布前数月出现。

events.onset_evidence: Gazprom announced on 2022-09-02 that flows through Nord Stream 1 would remain shut off indefinitely pending repair of the Portovaya compressor turbine, converting an earlier maintenance halt into an open-ended cutoff. Corroborated by the Wikipedia article 'Nord Stream 1' (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the announcement date.
events.notes: 渐进爬行型事件：供气数月递减、气价电价持续攀升，断供前应有大量可观测前兆（气价、库存、减产公告）。补 port_los_angeles_backlog_2021 / rhine 的爬行类孤例，并新增 geopolitical/energy 维度。

events.event_name: Renesas Naka fab fire halts auto chip supply
events.onset_evidence: Renesas reported a fire on 2021-03-19 in the N3 building (300 mm line) of its Naka factory in Hitachinaka, Ibaraki, halting automotive microcontroller production. Corroborated by the manufacturer's own press release, which dates the fire to Friday 2021-03-19 (checked 2026-09-30), and by the Wikipedia article '2020-2023 global chip shortage', which records the fire in March 2021.
events.notes: 突发型工厂事故；与 renesas_earthquake_2016（地震）同公司不同成因，补 toyota_steel_explosion_2019 的质量/事故类孤例，检验事故类预警的可复现性。

events.event_name: Taiwan Strait crisis (Pelosi visit and PLA drills)
events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia states that Pelosi visited Taiwan on August 2, 2022 (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches her arrival.
events.affected_region: Global semiconductor supply chain, Taiwan Strait shipping lanes
events.notes: Visit rumored from 2022-07-19 (FT report), confirmed late July: two weeks of documented precursor coverage. Semiconductor supply risk ties the case to this journal.

events.event_name: US Section 301 tariffs on China (trade war round 1)
events.onset_evidence: USTR Section 301: first USD 34B tariff list effective 2018-07-06.
events.notes: Months of Section 301 investigation and list-draft coverage before the effective date.

events.event_name: Hurricane Maria hits Puerto Rico (pharma manufacturing)
events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia records that Maria made landfall near Yabucoa, Puerto Rico, as a Category 4 hurricane at 10:15 UTC on 2017-09-20 (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the landfall date.
events.notes: Sudden; pharma angle fits the journal's HS&E stakes.

events.event_name: UAW targeted strike against Detroit Three automakers
events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia records that the strike began on September 15, 2023, when the union was unable to reach a deal with the three automakers (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches.
events.notes: Slow-burn: contract negotiations and strike authorization votes covered from July 2023.

events.event_name: Russia exits Black Sea Grain Initiative
events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia records that the Joint Coordination Centre was disbanded with the expiration of the initiative on 17 July 2023 (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches Russia's withdrawal.
events.notes: Slow-burn: Russia issued repeated exit threats across renewal cycles since Nov 2022.

events.event_name: India bans wheat exports after heat-wave crop damage
events.onset_evidence: DGFT notification banned wheat exports with immediate effect on 2022-05-14 after March-April heat waves cut the crop estimate.
events.notes: Slow-burn: heat-wave crop damage reported from March 2022; war disruption since Feb 2022.

events.event_name: US egg shortage and record prices amid H5N1 outbreaks
events.onset_evidence: US retail egg prices reached record highs and widespread shortages were reported from mid-January 2025 (BLS CPI) after H5N1 culling of >20M laying hens in late 2024.
events.notes: Slow-burn: H5N1 layer flock culling escalated through H2 2024.

events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia dates the invasion 24 February 2022 to present (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches the start of the invasion.
events.affected_region: Global energy, food, and metals supply
events.notes: Slow-burn: Russian troop build-up and invasion threats covered from November 2021; impact spans energy, grain, metals, and semiconductor neon gas.

events.onset_evidence: Wikipedia states that a major explosion caused by the ignition of 2,750 tonnes of ammonium nitrate occurred in Beirut on 2020-08-04 (checked 2026-09-30); the stored date matches.
events.notes: Sudden: port infrastructure destruction with no textual precursors expected; designed negative for a logistics accident.

revision_log.reason: Onset and event itself unverifiable. Ten Wikipedia searches (en+ja) find no 2019 Toyota engine-plant explosion or fire; the corpus contains no title with both 'toyota' and ('explosion'|'fire'); the nearest real analogue is the 1997 Aisin fire. Real 2019 incidents do not match: Sandvika hydrogen station explosion (Norway, June 2019) and a Daihatsu Nakatsu plant fire (2019-03-14). Retained hits were US steel-tariff articles under loose matching (DI-8).

Onset provenance registry completed. 7 entries previously marked draft-needs-verification (or confirmed-known) carried Chinese-language evidence and no citable source; all seven were re-verified against public sources and promoted to 'verified', with the source URL and access date recorded in onset_source / onset_source_accessed. No onset date was changed.
Registered source URLs for four further events whose dates were confirmed at content level against Wikipedia (Beirut explosion, Russian invasion, Black Sea Grain Initiative, Pelosi visit).
Registered source URLs for Hurricane Maria (landfall) and the 2023 UAW strike, both confirmed at content level.
